name: Dadar Central
description: Critical multimodal interchange in central Mumbai bridging Central Railway (Suburban & Outstation) and Western Railway. High-footfall station featuring three major Foot Overbridges (North, Central, South), accessible elevators, and multiple concourses.
platform_information: 7 active Central Railway platforms (renumbered 8 to 14 effective 9 Dec 2023). Western Railway operates platforms 1 to 7 separately. Former CR Platform 2 was surrendered and track dismantled to widen Platform 8.
entrances: East Entrance (Swami Gyan Jivandas Marg / Dadar TT)
West Entrance (Senapati Bapat Marg / Flower Market)
North Foot Overbridge Direct Access (Kabutarkhana Side)
exits: East Exit (Dadar TT Circle / BEST Bus Stop)
West Exit (Senapati Bapat Marg / Flower Market)
facilities_summary: 7 CR Platforms (8-14, Suburban Slow/Fast & Express Terminus)
Central Accessible Elevators (East Concourse, Platform 10, Platform 11)
source_method: Central Railway station layout renumbering notice (Dec 2023) & surveyed concourse layout
source_reference: Central Railway Press Release Ref: CR/BB/2023/12/03 & OSM Dadar node dataset

name: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus
description: Historic UNESCO World Heritage railway terminus serving Central Railway suburban (Harbour & Main line) and long-distance outstation trains. Station features Star concourse, heritage concourse, buffer stop stub platforms, and extensive pedestrian corridors.
platform_information: 18 terminal platforms (Suburban Platforms 1 to 7 serving Harbour and Mainline local services; Mainline Platforms 8 to 18 serving long-distance outstation express trains). Buffer stop stub terminus layout.
entrances: Main Heritage Concourse Gate (Dr. D.N. Road)
Subway Link to Fort Commercial District
exits: Dr. D.N. Road Main Heritage Exit
facilities_summary: Suburban Platforms 1-7 (Slow, Fast, Harbour Line buffers)
IRCTC Ahaar Food Court & Buffer Dining
source_method: Government open-data portal & OpenStreetMap public infrastructure tags
source_reference: OSM Station Relation CSMT (Way #4392019) & Central Railway Mumbai Division Guide

name: Byculla
description: Historic suburban station on the Central Line serving South-Central Mumbai, Jijamata Udyan (Byculla Zoo), and textile mill residential redevelopment corridors. Features an award-winning restored Victorian booking hall.
platform_information: 4 suburban mainline platforms (Platforms 1 & 2 for Slow corridor, Platforms 3 & 4 for Fast corridor). Restored Victorian-era heritage concourse.
entrances: West Entrance (Jijamata Udyan / Khada Parsi Side)
facilities_summary: Central Foot Overbridge with Platform Stairways
Platform 1 Public Conveniences & Drinking Water Points
source_method: Public railway timetables & OpenStreetMap station boundaries
source_reference: OSM Station Relation Byculla (Node #245892) & Mumbai Suburban network guide

name: Ghatkopar
description: Major multimodal transit hub providing direct elevated concourse interchange between Central Railway suburban trains and Mumbai Metro Line 1 (Versova-Andheri-Ghatkopar). High commuter transfer volume.
platform_information: 4 suburban mainline platforms (Platforms 1 & 2 for Slow lines, Platforms 3 & 4 for Fast lines). Multimodal elevated concourse provides direct interchange with Mumbai Metro Line 1.
facilities_summary: Direct Metro Line 1 Turnstiles & Elevated Transfer Deck
Metro Transfer Accessible Elevator to Platform 1
source_method: OpenStreetMap public tags & Mumbai Metro Line 1 transit maps
source_reference: OSM Relation #3910291 & MMRDA Line 1 Transit Guide

name: Thane
description: One of Indian Railways' highest-footfall junction stations, serving suburban main line, Trans-Harbour link to Navi Mumbai, and long-distance trains. Features the elevated SATIS bus concourse on the West.
platform_information: 10 active platforms (Platforms 1 to 4 Mainline suburban slow/fast, Platforms 5 to 8 Express through services, Platforms 9 & 10 Trans-Harbour to Navi Mumbai). Elevated SATIS bus deck on West side.
entrances: West Entrance (Gokhale Road / Talao Pali side)
Elevated SATIS Deck Entrance (TMT Bus Terminal)
East Entrance (Kopri / CIDCO Bus Terminal side)
facilities_summary: Elevated Bus-Terminal Deck (SATIS system with accessible ramp)
Central Foot Overbridge with multiple platform landings
CR Sahayata Help Desk & Digital Booking Counters
source_reference: TMC SATIS Infrastructure Project Report & OSM Station Relation #348210

name: Kalyan Junction
description: Crucial railway junction where Central Railway splits into the northeastern line (to Kasara, Nashik, North/East India) and southeastern line (to Karjat, Pune, South India). Heavy suburban terminus and junction traffic.
platform_information: 8 active junction platforms (Crucial rail bifurcation point where CR splits towards Kasara/Nashik and Karjat/Pune). Ongoing remodelling yard infrastructure under construction.
entrances: West Entrance (Kalyan Bus Depot & Market area)
facilities_summary: West Divyangjan Accessible Ramp to South FOB
West Main Concourse Booking Windows & ATVMs
Potable Water Stations & Station Master / RPF Post
source_reference: Central Railway Kalyan Junction Station Layout Plan & OSM Relation #384910
